anomalies.observed: On the EthernetAndPower sheet the label NET0004 is attached to pin 1 (TD+) of the RJ45 jack J7 and also to pin 1 (centre/positive) of the DC barrel jack J11. NET0004 is the battery/USB/adapter input rail on this sheet (it is the node fed by the barrel-jack centre pin and by the battery feed diode U9 and going on to C10/IC2 VIN), while the other three J7 data pins carry NET0007 / NET0013 / NET0027, which are the nets that actually run to the SKW92A (U10) WAN-port pins on the SkylabModule sheet.
anomalies.expected: The four data pins of J7 must connect only to the SKW92A WAN-port Ethernet nets (NET0007/NET0041/NET0013/NET0027); the DC-input / battery rail must not be connected to the Ethernet jack.

evidence.quote: EthernetAndPower sheet: wire from J7 pin 1 carries global label NET0004; wire from J11 pin 1 carries global label NET0004, with note '2 and 3 are shorted with no plug / 1 is center, center is positive'
DC barrel jack (J4, "Barrel_Jack_Switch"): ... Netlist: J4.1→BAT+ (center/positive), J4.2→GND (sleeve), J4.3→BAT-.

anomalies.impact: The Ethernet TD+ line is shorted to the battery/USB/DC power rail, so the WAN port cannot work and the rail is loaded by the RJ45 magnetics; at the same time one Ethernet pair of the SKW92A (the net that should reach J7 pin 1) is left unconnected at the jack.

parsed.summary: The only clear deviation found is on the EthernetAndPower sheet, where the power/battery rail net NET0004 is also attached to pin 1 of the RJ45 jack J7, bridging the DC/battery input rail with the Ethernet interface instead of routing that pin to the SKW92A WAN port; the rest of the power, reset, UART, keyboard, SD and EPD connections read as described in the specification.
